weeks.title: Stage 1 — First letter sounds
weeks.focus: Learn the first letter sounds and match them to pictures.
learns: Hear and say the first letter sounds
Match sounds to letters and pictures
Build sound confidence
weeks.mastery: Identifies the first letter sounds

weeks.title: Stage 2 — Letter sounds set 2
weeks.focus: Build quick recall of more letter sounds.
learns: Add new letter sounds
Blend early sounds in simple words
Spot sounds in words
weeks.mastery: Recalls the second sound set quickly

weeks.title: Stage 3 — Letter sounds set 3
weeks.focus: Add new letter sounds and use them in simple words.
learns: Learn new sounds in context
Blend CVC words with the new sounds
Recognize sounds in pictures
weeks.mastery: Blends CVC words with the new sounds

weeks.title: Stage 4 — Letter sounds set 4
weeks.focus: Practice additional consonant sounds with picture-word matching.
learns: Extend sound bank
Blend and segment simple words
Improve sound discrimination
weeks.mastery: Identifies and blends the new sounds

weeks.title: Stage 5 — Letter sounds set 5
weeks.focus: Complete the core set of letter sounds.
learns: Complete the core sound set
Blend across mixed sounds
Build confidence in recall
weeks.mastery: Completes core sound set confidently

weeks.title: Stage 6 — Short vowels + review
weeks.focus: Short vowels + review all sounds.
learns: Recognize short vowels
Blend with short vowels
Review all sounds
weeks.mastery: Reads short vowel CVC words

weeks.title: Stage 1 — Sound sets 1–5
weeks.focus: Blend sound sets 1–5 and read simple CVC words.
learns: Blend sound sets 1–5
Read simple CVC words
Build decoding confidence
weeks.mastery: Reads CVC words with sound sets 1–5

weeks.title: Stage 2 — Sound sets 6–7 + short vowels
weeks.focus: Finish sound sets + short vowels for smoother blending.
learns: Complete sound sets 6–7
Recognize short vowels quickly
Blend with short vowels
weeks.mastery: Blends short vowel words smoothly

weeks.title: Stage 3 — Digraphs + silent letters
weeks.focus: Learn digraphs and silent letters in words.
learns: Recognize common digraphs
Spot silent letters
Read words with digraphs
weeks.mastery: Reads digraph and silent-letter words

weeks.title: Stage 4 — Vowel teams + long vowels
weeks.focus: Practice vowel teams and long vowel patterns.
learns: Recognize vowel teams
Read long vowel words
Compare short vs long
weeks.mastery: Reads long vowel words with vowel teams

weeks.title: Stage 5 — Magic E
weeks.focus: Master Magic E long vowels.
learns: Understand the Magic E rule
Read Magic E words
Spell simple Magic E words
weeks.mastery: Reads Magic E words accurately

weeks.title: Stage 6 — Longer words + review
weeks.focus: Apply rules in longer words and review.
learns: Apply multiple patterns in words
Read longer words
Review key rules
weeks.mastery: Applies patterns in longer words

weeks.title: Stage 1 — Diphthongs
weeks.focus: Diphthongs and gliding vowel sounds.
learns: Recognize diphthongs
Read diphthong words
Hear sound glides
weeks.mastery: Reads diphthong words confidently

weeks.title: Stage 2 — Bossy R
weeks.focus: Bossy R patterns for ar/or/er/ir/ur.
learns: Recognize r-controlled vowels
Read r-controlled words
Compare ar/or/er/ir/ur
weeks.mastery: Reads r-controlled words accurately

weeks.title: Stage 3 — Special sounds + silent letters
weeks.focus: Special sounds and silent letter patterns.
learns: Recognize special sounds
Spot silent letters
Read tricky patterns
weeks.mastery: Reads special-sound words with accuracy

weeks.title: Stage 4 — Alternate vowels
weeks.focus: Alternate vowel spellings in words.
learns: Identify alternate vowel spellings
Choose correct vowel sound
Read words in context
weeks.mastery: Chooses correct alternate vowel sounds

weeks.title: Stage 5 — Endings
weeks.focus: Endings and suffix sounds.
learns: Recognize common endings
Read ending patterns
Spell ending sounds
weeks.mastery: Applies endings correctly in words

weeks.title: Stage 6 — Revision
weeks.focus: Mixed revision + fluency practice.
learns: Review all advanced patterns
Read with fluency
Build accuracy in connected text
weeks.mastery: Shows accuracy and confidence in mixed reading

weeks.title: Stage 1 — Word Foundations
weeks.focus: Goal: Identify and understand the main basic word types.
learns: Identify nouns, proper nouns, verbs, adjectives, and pronouns
Understand that different words do different jobs
Build a strong foundation in basic word types

weeks.title: Stage 2 — Grammar Basics
weeks.focus: Goal: Learn core grammar rules and usage basics.
learns: Understand one and many forms
Use singular and plural nouns correctly
Use a, an, and the correctly
Use simple prepositions such as in, on, under, and near

weeks.title: Stage 3 — Sentence Building
weeks.focus: Goal: Build correct sentences with proper punctuation.
learns: Understand how a sentence starts and ends
Use basic punctuation marks correctly
Build simple sentences
Form clear and meaningful sentences

weeks.title: Stage 4 — Conjunctions and Adverbs
weeks.focus: Goal: Connect ideas and add detail to sentences.
learns: Use conjunctions such as and, but, or, and because
Understand adverbs that tell how, when, and where
Make sentences longer, clearer, and more expressive

weeks.title: Stage 5 — Tenses Basics
weeks.focus: Goal: Learn the three basic tenses in a simple and gradual way.
learns: Understand simple present, simple past, and simple future
Use tense clues in sentences
Answer simple questions in sentence form
Practise tense usage in simple sentences

weeks.title: Stage 6 — Sentence Writing and Final Revision
weeks.focus: Goal: Apply learning to build and write meaningful sentences and short paragraphs.
learns: Arrange words in the correct order to make sentences
Improve short sentences by adding correct grammar and detail
Describe a picture using clear sentences
Write a short paragraph with support
Revise the full beginner grammar syllabus

weeks.title: Stage 1 — Tense Control
weeks.focus: Control tense choices and keep them consistent.
learns: Choose the right tense
Avoid tense shifts
Edit tense mistakes
weeks.mastery: Keeps tense consistent in writing

weeks.title: Stage 2 — Perfect Tenses + Modals
weeks.focus: Use perfect tenses and modals accurately.
learns: Use perfect tenses
Choose modals by meaning
Edit modal errors
weeks.mastery: Uses perfect tenses and modals accurately

weeks.title: Stage 3 — Clauses + Complex Sentences
weeks.focus: Build complex sentences with clauses.
learns: Identify clause types
Build complex sentences
Punctuate clauses
weeks.mastery: Writes complex sentences with clauses

weeks.title: Stage 4 — Voice + Reported Speech
weeks.focus: Use voice and reported speech clearly.
learns: Use active vs passive
Convert to reported speech
Edit for clarity
weeks.mastery: Uses voice and reported speech

weeks.title: Stage 5 — Paragraph Cohesion
weeks.focus: Write cohesive paragraphs with transitions.
learns: Use transitions
Organize paragraphs
Edit for flow
weeks.mastery: Writes cohesive paragraphs

weeks.title: Stage 6 — Tone + Argument + Impact
weeks.focus: Write with tone, argument, and impact.
learns: Adjust tone
Build claim + reason
Use evidence and word choice
weeks.mastery: Writes with clear tone and impact

weeks.title: Stage 1 — Connect & Communicate
weeks.focus: Enter a reciprocal conversation, respond to another person, and communicate a complete idea with growing independence.
learns: Participate in short back-and-forth exchanges
Respond to the listener rather than only recite prepared language
Use an audible, comfortable pace and a complete spoken response
Take turns and continue an interaction with less prompting
homework: Reflect on one thing that became easier
weeks.mastery: Uses the stage skill with less prompting on a fresh task

weeks.title: Stage 2 — Ask, Listen & Clarify
weeks.focus: Use questions to learn, listen for meaning, and repair misunderstandings.
learns: Use age-appropriate question words to seek information
Ask questions that are relevant to the topic
Answer the question that was actually asked
Ask a follow-up or clarification question when more information is needed
homework: Reflect on one thing that became easier
weeks.mastery: Uses the stage skill with less prompting on a fresh task

weeks.title: Stage 3 — Describe & Explain
weeks.focus: Expand an idea with useful detail, sequence, comparison, and simple reasons.
learns: Describe with relevant detail
Choose more precise vocabulary
Explain a simple sequence
Give a reason and make simple comparisons
homework: Reflect on one thing that became easier
weeks.mastery: Uses the stage skill with less prompting on a fresh task

weeks.title: Stage 4 — Story & Perspective
weeks.focus: Tell and retell coherent stories while beginning to consider another person's perspective.
learns: Use a clear beginning, middle, and end
Include character, setting, problem, feeling, and relevant detail
Retell without depending on a memorised script
Consider what another character may know, feel, or think
homework: Reflect on one thing that became easier
weeks.mastery: Uses the stage skill with less prompting on a fresh task

weeks.title: Stage 5 — Short Talks & Audience
weeks.focus: Organise a short message for a listener and respond to simple audience questions.
learns: Choose a clear topic and key message
Support the message with relevant details
Use a visual or prop without becoming dependent on it
Adjust pace, emphasis, and information for the listener
Answer simple questions after a short talk
homework: Reflect on one thing that became easier
weeks.mastery: Uses the stage skill with less prompting on a fresh task

weeks.title: Stage 6 — Independent Communication & Smart Questioning
weeks.focus: Plan, communicate, question, check information, and reflect with less adult construction of the response.
learns: Plan an idea before speaking
Ask for help or clarification without giving up
Give clear instructions another person can follow
Recognise that better questions can produce better information
Distinguish a supported fact from a guess or uncertain answer
Transfer communication skills to a fresh task
homework: Reflect on one thing that became easier
weeks.mastery: Uses the stage skill with less prompting on a fresh task

weeks.title: Stage 1 — Purpose, Audience & Delivery
weeks.focus: Shape a clear spoken message according to purpose, audience, and task.
learns: Distinguish informing, explaining, and persuading
Adapt content and detail for the listener or audience
Open clearly and answer the core question before expanding
Use articulation, pace, pausing, and emphasis to support meaning
homework: Reflect on one thing that became easier
weeks.mastery: Uses the stage skill with less prompting on a fresh task

weeks.title: Stage 2 — Questioning, Listening & Dialogue
weeks.focus: Use questioning and active listening to sustain purposeful two-way communication.
learns: Choose open, closed, clarifying, follow-up, and probing questions for a purpose
Paraphrase another speaker accurately before responding
Build on another person's idea
Sustain an interview or dialogue across several turns
homework: Reflect on one thing that became easier
weeks.mastery: Uses the stage skill with less prompting on a fresh task

weeks.title: Stage 3 — Reasoning & Explanation
weeks.focus: Explain thinking clearly and support claims with reasons, examples, and appropriately checked information.
learns: Use claim → reason → example structure
Explain cause, effect, sequence, process, and trade-offs
Distinguish fact, opinion, and inference
Ask how a claim is known and what evidence or source supports it
homework: Reflect on one thing that became easier
weeks.mastery: Uses the stage skill with less prompting on a fresh task

weeks.title: Stage 4 — Story, Perspective & Impromptu Thinking
weeks.focus: Communicate flexibly when the topic, viewpoint, or question is not fully rehearsed.
learns: Build a coherent story with a purposeful hook and arc
Shift perspective and recognise that viewpoints can differ
Use a simple structure for impromptu responses
Use thinking time, brief notes, clarification, and recovery strategies
State uncertainty rather than inventing an answer
homework: Reflect on one thing that became easier
weeks.mastery: Uses the stage skill with less prompting on a fresh task

weeks.title: Stage 5 — Discussion, Persuasion & Mediation
weeks.focus: Participate constructively in discussion, persuasion, disagreement, and mediation of another person's ideas.
learns: Match persuasive reasons and evidence to an audience need
Agree and disagree respectfully while addressing the idea
Recognise and respond to a counterargument
Summarise or rephrase another person's idea fairly
Use discussion to refine thinking rather than only to win
homework: Reflect on one thing that became easier
weeks.mastery: Uses the stage skill with less prompting on a fresh task

weeks.title: Stage 6 — Presentation & AI-Era Communication
weeks.focus: Present independently and use AI-era communication skills with critical judgement, privacy awareness, and human responsibility.
learns: Plan a presentation around purpose, message, notes, visuals, and likely questions
Recognise useful AI capabilities and important limitations
Protect private information and keep human responsibility for decisions
Give a clear AI request using goal, context, and constraints when supervised use is appropriate
Evaluate an AI answer for relevance, evidence, missing context, possible bias, and uncertainty
homework: Reflect on one thing that became easier
weeks.mastery: Uses the stage skill with less prompting on a fresh task
